name: EMA
campus: Delivered in English on our Paris campus, the Bachelor Applied Management and Economics is a three-year programme that prepares students for management roles in an international environment.

In Year 1, you build a strong foundation in business and management, alongside applied mathematics, statistics and accounting. You also strengthen your French language proficiency, while building essential academic, digital and teamwork skills. You also explore key global challenges, including ethical and sustainability issues. Weekly career workshops support your professional development and a compulsory placement provides early workplace experience.
The Bachelor in Applied Management and Economics is a 3-year full-time programme, delivered in English on our Paris campus.
accommodation: There are no application fees. Tuition fees can be paid in two instalments. The school does not provide accommodation services, but offers practical advice to support students in their search. For full tuition details, please refer to the programme page on our website.

The MBA has around 20 hours of classes per week, so you can work outside class hours. The timetable is set by the school and cannot be arranged around individual working hours, but we do our best to keep it as convenient as possible. International students holding a student residence permit must respect the working-hours limit set by French law.
